$comment: The single source of truth for which backend responses we have actually observed.
Both scripts/record-contract.mjs and scripts/check-contract.mjs read this file,
and scripts/coverage.mjs diffs it against docs/api/swagger.snapshot.json to answer
'what do we not know yet?'. Adding an endpoint is an edit here, not to a script.
op       METHOD + path, exactly as keyed in the OpenAPI document.
sample   Query string used when recording. Prefer a large pageSize: nullable
fields only reveal themselves across a wide enough sample.
schema   Named export from lib/api/schemas/catalog.ts. Omit (null) when the
shape has been recorded but not yet modelled — coverage counts only
itemsAt  Dotted path to the array whose per-field nullability we summarise.
auth     true → recorded only when CONTRACT_TOKEN is set.
An invented schema is worse than none: it alarms on the truth. Leave schema null
until a real response has been observed.

endpoints.label: cart
endpoints.$why: Only ever observed empty, so the item shape is genuinely unknown. Modelling it now would be a guess.

endpoints.label: cart-related
endpoints.$why: A bare array — no envelope, and items are neither Product nor MaterialSummary.

endpoints.label: admin-products-create
endpoints.$why: Recorded by scripts/record-mutations.mjs. Returns ApiEnvelope<Product> — the same 41 fields as GET /Products.

endpoints.label: admin-products-update
endpoints.$why: Recorded. ApiEnvelope<Product>. NOTE: UpdateProductDto omits brandType/productType and adds isActive.

endpoints.label: admin-products-delete
endpoints.$why: Recorded. data is a bare boolean, not a Product.

endpoints.label: admin-products-bulk
endpoints.$why: Recorded. Created rows arrive under data.createdProducts, NOT data[] like every other create on this surface.

endpoints.label: admin-product-image
endpoints.$why: Multipart, field `file`. Returns ApiEnvelope<ProductImageDto>. Recorded by scripts/explore-image-upload.mjs; now in the refreshed snapshot.

endpoints.label: ai-styles
endpoints.$why: A bare array of { id, name } — no envelope. Public. The `style` field on GenerateImageDto/GenerateVideoDto takes the id.

endpoints.label: orders-my-orders
endpoints.$why: data is a bare array, NOT data.items like /Products — this manifest entry had itemsAt wrong until 2026-08-11. Confirmed live: scripts/record-order-shape.mjs + manual curl, see contracts/orders.json.

endpoints.label: product-reviews
endpoints.$why: Templated path — contract:record can't hit it. Recorded manually against a live product; every product checked has zero reviews, so items[]'s element shape is unmodelled (z.unknown()). See contracts/product-reviews.json.

endpoints.label: orders-detail
endpoints.$why: Templated path — contract:record can't hit it. Recorded by scripts/record-order-shape.mjs --write, which places one order and cancels it. See contracts/orders.json.

endpoints.label: orders-create
endpoints.$why: Mutation — recorded by scripts/record-order-shape.mjs --write. Was 500ing on a SQL sequence defect until 2026-08-11 (BACKLOG.md item 7); now 201s. Same envelope shape as the detail GET.

endpoints.label: vendor-orders
endpoints.$why: No envelope — bare { items, total, page, pageSize }. List-item shape only; the detail GET (GET /vendor/orders/{orderId}) has not been observed on success, only its 403 scope-error shape (contracts/orders.json).

endpoints.label: checkout
endpoints.$why: No envelope. Recorded by scripts/record-checkout-shape.mjs; see contracts/checkout.json.

endpoints.label: checkout-payment
endpoints.$why: Mutation — initiates a real (test-mode) Paystack session. Recorded by scripts/record-checkout-shape.mjs --write, confirmed live 2026-08-11. See contracts/checkout.json.

endpoints.label: checkout-verify
endpoints.$why: Templated path — contract:record can't hit it. Recorded by scripts/record-checkout-shape.mjs --write. Observed paymentStatus: "Failed" for a reference never completed at Paystack — a 200, not an error.

endpoints.label: portfolio
endpoints.$why: The public before/after showcase behind /project. Enveloped, but the pagination block is the un-enveloped style — data.{items,totalCount,page,pageSize,totalPages,hasMore}, not Paged's pageNumber/hasNextPage. Each item carries beforeImages[], afterImages[], referenceImages[] and thumbnailUrl.

endpoints.label: consultations-types
endpoints.$why: Bare array in data, 5 seeded types. contracts/consultations-types.json.

endpoints.label: consultations-mine
endpoints.$why: Bare array in data, NOT the ConsultationPagedResultDto the spec associates elsewhere. contracts/consultations-mine.json.

endpoints.label: consultation-availability
endpoints.$why: Needs a ?type= query param — contract:record can't parameterise. Recorded manually. contracts/consultation-booking-paid.json has the type sub-shape; slots[] shape recorded ad hoc, matches ConsultationSlotDto exactly.

endpoints.label: consultation-booking
endpoints.$why: Mutation — recorded by scripts/record-consultation-shape.mjs --write (both a free and a test-mode-paid type, each cancelled after). See contracts/consultation-booking-{free,paid}.json.

endpoints.label: consultation-payment-init
endpoints.$why: Mutation, initiates a real (test-mode) Paystack session — recorded by scripts/record-consultation-shape.mjs --write. Enveloped, unlike POST /checkout/payment's equivalent. See contracts/consultation-booking-paid.json.

endpoints.label: consultation-verify-payment
endpoints.$why: Mutation. Only the failure shape (400, data: null) has been observed — recorded by scripts/record-consultation-shape.mjs --write. A completed payment's success shape is unconfirmed.

endpoints.label: consultation-detail
endpoints.$why: Templated path — contract:record can't hit it. Recorded by scripts/record-consultation-shape.mjs --write. See contracts/consultation-booking-{free,paid}.json.

endpoints.label: consultation-reschedule
endpoints.$why: Mutation. Same enveloped bare ConsultationDto as GET /consultations/{id} — recorded manually. See contracts/consultation-reschedule-cancel.json.

endpoints.label: consultation-cancel
endpoints.$why: Mutation. Same enveloped bare ConsultationDto, now with cancelledAtUtc/cancellationReason populated — recorded manually. See contracts/consultation-reschedule-cancel.json. PUT .../cancel (the sibling route) shares the same DTO; not separately recorded — this app calls the POST form.

endpoints.label: admin-consultations
endpoints.$why: Admin booking list. Paged: data.{items,page,pageSize,totalCount} — no totalPages/hasMore (ConsultationPagedResultDto). A separate table from the legacy /admin/inspections; this is what the app's booking flow writes into.

endpoints.label: admin-consultations-pricing
endpoints.$why: Per-type fee config; same rows (same ids) as /admin/inspections/pricing, and the source of `fee` on /consultations/types.

endpoints.label: admin-consultation-cancel
endpoints.$why: Mutation — recorded manually 2026-08-22 by cancelling the orphaned guest booking "Anon Check" (BACKLOG). Returns ApiEnvelope<ConsultationDto>, same item shape as the list; cancellation policy lives in `message`.

endpoints.label: admin-consultation-pricing-update
endpoints.$why: Mutation — recorded manually 2026-08-22 with a no-op write (same values back). Returns ApiEnvelope<ConsultationPricingConfigDto>.

endpoints.label: designs
endpoints.$why: No envelope — bare { designs, pagination } with /flooring-style page/limit/total/hasMore. Default limit is 10 and pageSize is ignored. roomType/search/page/limit/sortBy=newest|oldest are honoured; sortBy=favorites|alphabetical are accepted and ignored (confirmed 2026-08-25 by toggling a favourite). See contracts/designs.json.

endpoints.label: designs-detail
endpoints.$why: Templated path — contract:record can't hit it. Recorded manually 2026-08-25. No envelope, and NOT the list row: the image is outputUrl, plus width/height/durationSeconds. See contracts/designs-detail.json.

endpoints.label: designs-download
endpoints.$why: Templated path. Recorded manually 2026-08-25 with and without ?quality=high — same { success, downloadUrl } either way. See contracts/designs-detail.json.

endpoints.label: designs-favorite
endpoints.$why: Mutation — a reversible toggle on the recorder's own design, toggled straight back. Recorded manually 2026-08-25. No envelope: { success, isFavorite }. See contracts/designs-detail.json.

endpoints.label: projects-create
endpoints.$why: Mutation, recorded manually 2026-08-25 (scripts run ad hoc, not checked in) for the design-card "make into a project" action. Enveloped, unlike GET /Designs. No DELETE /projects/{id} exists, so the call left one permanent row in the dev database, name-prefixed "Contract Recorder Test Project". See contracts/projects-create.json.

endpoints.label: renovation-estimate
endpoints.$why: Mutation, recorded manually 2026-08-25 for the design-card "get estimate" action. No envelope. No DELETE endpoint exists for a renovation estimate, so the call left one permanent row in the dev database, name-prefixed "Contract Recorder Test Estimate". See contracts/renovation-estimate.json.

endpoints.label: renovation-estimates-list
endpoints.$why: Recorded manually 2026-08-25 for the "My Estimates" / BOQ history list. No envelope: { estimates: [...] }, a lighter summary per row than the full estimate. GET /ai/renovation-estimates (hyphenated) returns the identical shape for the same resource — confirmed live; the app calls the nested family for consistency with POST /ai/renovation/estimate. See contracts/renovation-estimates-list.json.

endpoints.label: renovation-estimate-detail
endpoints.$why: Templated path — contract:record can't hit it. Recorded manually 2026-08-25 for the estimate detail page. Same shape as POST /ai/renovation/estimate — reuses that schema. See contracts/renovation-estimates-list.json.
